# Isaiah Chapter 60 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 22 verses]*

*Light dawns; nations come; wealth flows in; sun no more needed; God is everlasting light*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen upon you. This chapter light dawns.

*-- LOGOS*
